title: Pricing Extra Vehicle Permits by Site Layout: Community Rules & Site Care Guidance
content:
The permit charge for a month on a Community Rules & Site Care plan record is priced by how the site holds the extra vehicles, the home section being read from the Home-Site Lease:

- **Two or more permits charged:** the first permit is charged the permit rate and each further permit 2 times the permit rate.
- **Exactly one permit charged on a multi-section home site:** the double-width driveway of a multi-section home holds the extra vehicle on the site, and that permit is charged 0.5 of the permit rate — one half — rounded up to the next whole dollar.
- **Otherwise** — exactly one permit on a single-section home site, or no permit at all — each permit is charged the permit rate.

The rounding up to the next whole dollar belongs only to the single permit on a multi-section home site.

## Input, judgement, permit charge

Hypothetical permit rate of $15.00:

| Permits charged | Home on the site | Judgement | Permit charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | either section | first permit at $15.00, two further permits at $30.00 each | $75.00 |
| 2 | either section | first permit at $15.00, one further permit at $30.00 | $45.00 |
| 1 | multi-section | half of $15.00 is $7.50, rounded up to the next whole dollar | $8.00 |
| 1 | single-section | the permit rate | $15.00 |
| 0 | either section | no permit | nothing |

With a hypothetical permit rate of $12.00, a single permit on a multi-section home site is charged half of $12.00, which is $6.00 exactly and needs no rounding; two permits on the same site come to $12.00 for the first and $24.00 for the second, $36.00 in all.
